description.en: Video rendering and timeline components for React, built on Editframe.
description.zh: 基于 Editframe 构建的 React 视频合成、时间轴编辑与多媒体动效组件。

content.en: framecn delivers programmatic video rendering and dynamic canvas composition components for React. Built on Editframe and styled within the shadcn aesthetic, it allows developers to build browser-based video editors, animated social clips, and programmatic timeline renders.
content.zh: framecn 是一套专为浏览器端多媒体合成与程序化视频渲染打造的 React 组件套件。依托 Editframe 视频管线与 shadcn 极简交互界面，它使开发者能够轻松在网页中构建多轨道时间轴、关键帧动画编排以及动态视频片段导出功能。
